        green_id = n['id']
        print(f"\nGreen block adjacency:")
        for a in seg['adjacency_list']:
            if a[0] == green_id or a[1] == green_id:
                other = a[1] if a[0] == green_id else a[0]
                other_node = seg['nodes'][other]
                print(f"  Green connected to: id={other}, color={other_node['color']}, pixels={other_node['pixels']}")
